integrity: Entire signed chain complex in the needed degrees is reconstructed for all 324 endpoint pairs from an explicit LCF graph; all Smith forms checked over integers.
scientific_limitations: A single 18-vertex graph and bidegree (3,4); no claim of a general girth-six theorem or automorphism-module classification. Mod-two ranks were already known; only the integral torsion-free lift is asserted.
title: Integral first off-diagonal magnitude homology of the Pappus graph
